question: Which of the following options is FALSE in relation to the papillary intraductal pancreatic mucinous tumor?

options.opb: They can affect both the main pancreatic duct and the secondary branches and are characterized by mucin-producing epithelium.
options.opc: The presence of nodules in the wall of the lesion does not constitute a sign of alarm.
options.opd: When it affects the secondary branches, surgical resection is indicated if it is greater than 3 cm.
